context: Two students debate who qualifies for the benefit
purpose: Debate eligibility; teach 世帯/適用/原則/所得/制限/財源/当事者/協議/支持/福祉

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: この制度、全世帯に適用されるの？
lines.en: Does this apply to all households?
lines.style: curious teen seeking the broad picture

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: いや、原則は低所得層だけだよ。
lines.en: No, in principle only low-income groups.
lines.style: knowledgeable peer correcting gently, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 所得の制限がけっこう厳しいね。
lines.en: The income limit is pretty strict.
lines.style: reacting teen weighing the harshness, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 財源が限られてるから仕方ないみたい。
lines.en: Funding’s limited, so it seems unavoidable.
lines.style: pragmatic peer explaining the constraint, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 当事者からは不満も出てるって。
lines.style: informed teen relaying the friction, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: だから国会でも何度も協議されてる。
lines.en: That’s why it’s debated repeatedly in the Diet.
lines.style: analytical peer noting the political churn

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 世論の支持がないと通らないよね。
lines.en: It won’t pass without public support, right?
lines.style: shrewd teen grasping the politics, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 福祉の充実は誰もが願うことだけどね。
lines.en: Though everyone wishes for richer welfare.
lines.style: reflective peer acknowledging the ideal, voice clear and distinctly their own
